thread:
Ashley: Heads up — I found a hole in /api/v1/roles/grant. Service tokens can grant high-priv roles without an explicit permission check. :eyes:
Omar: can you paste the minimal repro?
Ashley: repro below. very small: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.api.redwood.ai/api/v1/roles/grant \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"user_id":"U-789","role":"billing_admin"}'
```
Ashley: logs show 200 + role applied. no secondary auth or approval.
Kai: who owns that endpoint? product or platform?
Omar: eng-platform owns the granting middleware, product owns role semantics. sending to both.
Lucy: omg — billing_admin is effectively full billing read/write for orgs. we must assume some tokens leaked/compromised.
Nina: quick question: are these events landing in audit logs? if not we need to enable retention ASAP.
Ashley: that's the weird part — the audit pipeline recorded a different event_type: `role_update` for the API, but our audit-query dashboard looks for `role_change`. result: no entries surfaced for these grants.
Omar: ugh, so two issues: missing permission check + audit event mapping mismatch.
audit-bot: Detected anomalous role grant activity: 2026-03-20T15:04:12Z — 3 grants from service-token-42. (auto-alert) :rotating_light:
Kai: severity? I think P1: ability to escalate to billing_admin silently.
Ashley: agree P1. proposed immediate actions: 1) WAF rule to block POST /api/v1/roles/grant from service tokens; 2) emergency patch to middleware to require `actor_type=human` OR an allowlist for token ids; 3) rotate service tokens that used the endpoint; 4) fix audit-event type mapping and backfill.
Omar: I can push a WAF rule in 10m and add an emergency feature-flag guard to the middleware. patch owner: @omar.
Nina: audit log backfill needs access to KMS for the S3 bucket (server-side encryption). current key policy denies cross-account write from the logging lambda. I'll open a PR to add the logging-service principal.
Ashley: add Legal and Compliance to the loop — we need to know if we must notify customers. @Legal can you advise on notification thresholds for role-grant exposures?
Legal: copying in privacy. Need: scope (how many orgs affected) + timeline + token owners. We'll triage ASAP.
Lucy: product risk: some orgs have billing_admin tied to invoice access. high sensitivity.
Kai: rotating service tokens: list I have from deployment logs: service-token-42, service-token-99. rotating now. I'll revoke and issue new tokens with a restrict flag.
Omar: quick mitigation deployed: WAF rule applied to block non-human agents from that endpoint. feature flag `require_actor_human` enabled. patch landed to add authz check (rollout v2.1.8-hotfix).
Ashley: confirmed WAF block stopped new attempts. still seeing 3 grants in the last 24h that happened pre-mitigation.
Nina: audit backfill started. note: backfill will rewrite events to include standardized fields: `actor_id`, `actor_type`, `role`, `org_id`, `source_token_id`. We'll S3-encrypt with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234. I need eng-security to approve the key policy change (grant kms:Encrypt kms:Decrypt to logging-lambda principal).
Omar: +1 from platform. Ashley, can you confirm we want KMS policy change to allow log writer only?
Ashley: yes, narrow scope only to logging-lambda with explicit conditions. log retention: keep 1y, legal advised.
Legal: we need a timeline for customer impact assessment by EOD.
Ashley: owner assignments: containment = Kai; patch + authz fix = Omar; audit backfill + KMS = Nina; customer impact + legal = Lucy + Legal; postmortem = Ashley.
SRE: starting metrics runbook to look for abnormal role grant delta across last 90d.
Omar: follow-up tasks: (1) add unit test for role grant authz; (2) add integration test asserting audit event type = `role_change`; (3) add monitoring alert when grant rate > baseline.
Ashley: proposed comms: internal all-hands note + targeted customer outreach if we find affected orgs. hold public disclosure until after legal review.
Kai: rolling token rotation done for listed tokens, ops ticket #OPS-5421.
Nina: KMS policy PR opened: #infra/PR-678. tagging @Ashley for approval.
Ashley: approved the KMS PR. also booking 1hr postmortem slot tomorrow.
Lucy: thanks everyone. we'll draft a notification template once we know affected orgs.
Legal: we may need to inform SOC2 auditor depending on scope.
Ashley: next steps recap in one line: block endpoint (done), rotate tokens (done for known ones), patch middleware (done), backfill audit logs (in progress), KMS policy change (PR open), postmortem + customer assessment (owners assigned).
Omar: leaving a note — add a 2nd approver for role grants in product UI as long-term mitigation.
Ashley: agreed. we'll add that to roadmap and link to postmortem action items. :memo:
Kai: closing incident channel once postmortem scheduled and legal sign-off on comms. :white_check_mark:
notes: incident-type: privilege-escalation; initial-severity: P1; mitigation-status: partial; owner: Ashley (security)
